violation_type.title: Medication Records - Kept for 3 Months (26 TAC §746.3805(d))
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered during the investigation that operation did not have medication records available for a child that counter medication had been administered to.

finding_variants.text: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered during the investigation that operation did not have medication records available for a child that counter medication had been administered to.

Based on the preponderance of evidence gathered, sufficient evidence exists to determine deficiencies in maintaining medication administration records for a child, as the records provided were incomplete and lacked entries for several days during May, June, and July while the child was in care.
The operation have not kept documentation of adminitative medication of dose of children under their care for the last three months.
Medication records were not available for review.
